meta.description: Leaf builds Shopify apps that find the money hiding between your systems. Where we come from, what we believe, and how we work.

hero.headline: About <accent>Leaf</accent> Digital
hero.subhead: Leaf builds Shopify apps that find the money hiding between your systems. Where we come from, what we believe, and how we work.

origin.title: Where we come from
origin.one: Leaf started inside Shopify stores — years spent hands-on, building and fixing them for brands, sitting in the same chair you sit in at 11pm. And in every store, the same thing: <lead>the money never dies in a feature. It dies in the seams.</lead> Shopify tells you one number, the 3PL tells you another, and everything expensive stays invisible.
origin.two: Nobody owned that problem. So we do. That’s why we build Leaf apps — <imageVoice>Image Voice</imageVoice>, <reorderLoop>Reorder Loop</reorderLoop>, <countCheck>Count Check</countCheck> and <runway>Runway</runway> — each one aimed at a single seam, each one built to find the money hiding there and then do the work itself.

two.statement: Everything expensive is invisible until something drags it into the light.

three.statement: Beauty means visible evidence that someone gave full presence to the problem.
three.body: Apps built like well-made machines: solid, quiet, nothing rattling.

work.title: How we work
work.approval: Nothing touches your store without your approval, and every change undoes for 30 days.
work.reconcile: Numbers that tie out to Shopify’s own reports — if it doesn’t reconcile, it doesn’t ship.
work.fit: If our plans don’t fit your store, we say so and offer a waitlist instead of a sale.
work.replies: Replies to any email reach the person who built the app — not a bot.

who.a: Leaf is a small team that spent years building and fixing Shopify stores for brands before building apps. Every app comes from a problem we watched cost real stores real money. Replies to any email reach the person who built the app.

safe.q: Is my store data safe with Leaf apps?
safe.a: Each app requests the narrowest Shopify permissions it can run on, changes nothing without your approval, and every change can be undone for 30 days. You can see every action in the app’s activity trail.

uninstall.a: Your store keeps everything the app wrote — nothing is deleted or held hostage. You can leave any time; there are no annual contracts.

free.q: Do Leaf apps have free plans?
free.a: Yes. Every Leaf app starts with a free scan that shows you what it found on your own store before you pay anything, and prices are always published — no sales calls, no custom quotes.

cta.title: The best introduction is your own store.
cta.sub: Run the free scan, see what it finds, and judge for yourself.
cta.note: Curious where the rest hides? <apps>See what else is in the lab</apps>, or read <guide>the complete guide to alt text on Shopify</guide>.
